text:
anya-peopleops: Hey team — quick question for onboarding coordination. New hire @raj is on OPT STEM, his EAD expires in 3 months and he's planning a short trip abroad next month. He just told me he needs to update his US mailing address (moving apartments) mid-onboarding. Can we confirm risks and the steps we should advise him?

raj: yep that's me. travel is 10 days to visit family, return before the EAD expires. moving on the 1st of next month. i already started the I-765 for STEM. do i need to delay moving?

luis-legal: short answer — changing your mailing address is doable but we need to be careful. If I-765 is pending, USCIS will send the receipt and the EAD to the address on file. If you change address after filing, file AR-11 (online) and also update the specific case address with USCIS so the pending receipt goes to new address.

katie-peopleops: we can help with the courier forwarding on our side (we do it for critical onboarding docs). But USCIS mail doesn't always respect forwarding. Suggest keeping a stable address for 4 months from filing if possible.

raj: hmm — i can't keep the old apt past the move date. what's the minimum? and travel risk? if my EAD is pending and i travel, will it break anything?

luis-legal: travel while OPT STEM extension (I-765) is pending carries risk: reentry on OPT typically requires a valid EAD + F-1 docs; returning on a pending I-765 is risky because you don't have the new EAD yet. If you have a valid unexpired EAD from prior OPT and proper F-1 documents, you may be ok; but if your current EAD is expiring soon, i'd avoid international travel until you have either the new EAD or a clear plan.

anya-peopleops: practical steps for raj: 1) file AR-11 online immediately when you have new address (we can walk you through). 2) Use USCIS online account to change the address for the I-765 case number after AR-11. 3) Leave mail forwarding with USPS for 3 months. 4) If you must travel, check with Luis and share passport, visa, I-20 with travel signature, and current EAD; we can also open a case with our immigration counsel to get explicit guidance.

raj: thanks. can ppl-ops / legal help file AR-11 or do i need to do it personally?

katie-peopleops: AR-11 must be filed by the individual, but we can screen-share and help. we'll set up a 15-min slot today. also we can prepare a concierge letter for the carrier if the EAD shows up and you need expedited pickup.

luis-legal: one more note: USCIS will sometimes issue the EAD to the address on the receipt notice even if AR-11 is filed right after; there's a lag. If the EAD is time-sensitive, consider asking for a secure pickup at the nearest USCIS field office once the card is produced (requires coordinate with counsel). Premium processing is not available for I-765 STEM extension.

immigration-bot: reminder — typical I-765 processing time for STEM extension right now ~ 3–5 months; auto-extension of employment authorization for timely-filed I-765 exists (180-day rule) only if applicable — verify case specifics.

anya-peopleops: ok action items: raj — don't travel unless current EAD + travel docs are solid; file AR-11 today and message us when done; katie & luis — schedule quick 15-min to help file and review travel risk. i'll coordinate calendar. :thumbsup:

raj: filing AR-11 now, will ping when done. really appreciate the help!
